# Generated by tools/goethe-a2-candidates.js from the recorded gap file of this level
# (tools/goethe-b1-gap.txt), whose open entries ARE the un-authored set;
# the lines marked met there are this pool. The gap file itself came from the full list read
# whole, so no line here can be off the list.
# Every line was verified against the corpus: authored lines and lines the corpus does not
# carry are excluded. Promoting an entry means naming it in a word list; the matcher then
# verifies authored AND met before the entry counts, so this file can never overstate.
